Nancy Coleman
6831 Ridge Blvd., #14 (718) 680-2416
Brooklyn, NY 11220
December 22, 1994
Ms. Denise F. Keane Vice President & Deputy General Counsel Philip Morris Management Corp. 120 Park Avenue New York, NY 10017-5592
Dear Ms. Keane:
I am in receipt of your letter of December 14 responding to my letter requesting the removal of outdoor advertising for your products located within 500 feet of schools, houses of worship, playgrounds, and other centers of youth activity in my neighbor- hood of Bay Ridge, Brooklyn.
May I request a copy of the Cigarette Advertising and Promotion Code in order that I may make the most informed response possible to your stated position.
Thank you very much for your attention to this matter.
Sincerely, Drug Clean
Nancy Coleman
cc: Joe Cherner, President - SmokeFree Educational Services, Inc.
RECEIVED DEC 2 7 1994
:
DENISE F. KEANE
2044429056
